name: SunFounder GPIO Extension Board (T-board)
frame: Local mm frame: pin 1 at the origin; +x runs along the stem from pin 1 toward pin 39; +y runs from the odd-pin row toward the even-pin row (6 pitches). The header and top bar lie at negative x.

header.keySlotWall: the long wall at the -x side (away from the stem)

values.rowSpacingPitches: ADR-0004: the underside photo measures 6.013 pitch (15.27 mm) and the holes are on a 2.54 grid; Adafruit T-Cobbler Plus prior 15.24 mm
values.edgeColumnsUsable: SPEC 6.3 bench fact: leads seat in b or c beside a d pin; HIL_CHECKLIST confirms
values.pins: Labels read from reference photos 3 and 6 (docs/v2/reference/IMAGES.md), matching SPEC 6.3; pin n joins Pi header pin n through the straight-through ribbon
values.outline.stem: ADR-0004 calibrated photo: stem 20 mm wide, 2.37 mm outside each pin row; ends 7.97 mm past pin 39 (19 x 2.54 + 7.97 = 56.23); the bar's bottom edge is 1.83 mm before pin 1
values.outline.topBar: ADR-0004 calibrated photo: 57.7 mm wide (centred on the stem), 13.57 mm deep; pin 1 is 15.40 mm from the top edge
values.outline.cornerRadiusMm: Adafruit T-Cobbler Plus board file prior (2.54 mm corner arcs)
values.outline.pcbThicknessMm: Assumption: standard 1.6 mm FR-4 (not measurable from the photos)
values.header: ADR-0004: centre 11.40 mm before pin 1 and 4.00 mm from the top edge (photo); size from the DC3-40P listing (58.5 x 8.5 x 11.5 mm), the Adafruit outline (about 58.4 x 9.0 mm) and the photo's 11 mm callout; key slot on the outer long wall (photos 3, 4, 6). Which end carries header pin 1 is not yet measured
values.mountingHoles: ADR-0004: in line with the pin rows, 5.51 mm past pin 39 (photo); diameter 2.5 mm from the Adafruit prior
values.dupontHousingMm: Pololu 0.1 in crimp housings, 1x1: B = 2.54 mm (https://www.pololu.com/product/1900)
